basic_details.job_title: PAU Senior Lab/ Field Helper Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Punjab Agricultural University (PAU), Ludhiana is filling the post of Senior Lab/Field Helper in its Department of Plant Pathology on contract basis. The fixed remuneration is Rs.15,414/-+800/- (additional) per month, and there is 1 vacancy (1 for the post - the notice does not print a number). Applications on plain paper go to the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana, and must arrive before 2 November 2026. Applicants then appear before the selection committee on 6 November 2026 at 11.30 a.m.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 18 to 50 Years.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Write the application on plain paper. It must be complete in all respects. Send it to this address: The Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana. The application must reach the office before 2 November 2026. Applications that arrive after the due date, or without the application fee, will not be considered. Make the bank draft in favour of the Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana, payable at Ludhiana, and enclose it with the application.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: The post of Senior Lab/Field Helper is filled on contract basis at a fixed remuneration of Rs.15,414/-+800/- (additional) per month. Applicants need one of these three: 10+2 with Punjabi upto Matric Level with four years' experience as Jr. Field/ Lab Helper /Lab -coordinator, OR Matric with Punjabi with eight years experience as Jr. Field/ Lab Helper /Lab -coordinator, OR Middle with Punjabi with ten years experience as Jr. Field/ Lab Helper /Lab -coordinator. Preference will be given to candidates who are already assisting in the conduct of field experiments or handling the sample for Laboratory Analysis. The age limit is 18 to 50 Years. 25% of posts are reserved for Scheduled Castes/Tribes belonging to Punjab State. 12% of posts are reserved for Backward Classes belonging to Punjab State. 13% of posts are reserved for Ex-servicemen. 3% of posts are reserved for physically handicapped persons.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Attested copies of testimonials Bank draft of Rs.50/- in favour of the Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana, payable at Ludhiana

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Applicants must appear before the selection committee for verification of documents on 6 November 2026 at 11.30 a.m. This takes place in the office of the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana. Bring your original certificates.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PAU Recruitment 2026 for Senior Lab/Field Helper?
faq.answer: There is 1 vacancy for Senior Lab/Field Helper in the Department of Plant Pathology. The notice does not print a number.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PAU Senior Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: Applications must reach the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana before 2 November 2026. Applications that arrive after the due date will not be considered.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification do I need for the PAU Senior Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: You need one of these: 10+2 with Punjabi upto Matric Level and four years' experience, Matric with Punjabi and eight years' experience, or Middle with Punjabi and ten years' experience. In each case the experience must be as Jr. Field/ Lab Helper /Lab -coordinator.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the PAU Senior Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 to 50 Years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of a PAU Senior Lab/Field Helper?
faq.answer: The post has a fixed remuneration of Rs.15,414/-+800/- (additional) per month, on contract basis.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for PAU Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs.50/-, paid by bank draft in favour of the Comptroller, PAU, Ludhiana, payable at Ludhiana. Applications without the fee will not be considered.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for the PAU Senior Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: Send an application on plain paper to the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana. It must be complete in all respects and include attested copies of testimonials and the Rs.50/- bank draft, and it must arrive before 2 November 2026.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PAU Senior Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: Applicants appear before the selection committee for verification of documents on 6 November 2026 at 11.30 a.m. This is in the office of the Head, Department of Plant Pathology, PAU, Ludhiana, and you must bring your original certificates.

faq.question: Q9. Is the PAU Senior Lab/Field Helper post permanent?
faq.answer: No. The post is filled on contract basis at a fixed remuneration.

faq.question: Q10. Who gets preference for the PAU Senior Lab/Field Helper post?
faq.answer: Preference will be given to candidates who are already assisting in the conduct of field experiments or handling the sample for Laboratory Analysis.
